title: SC-07-13-02 The daily late-fee job is idempotent
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the daily late-fee job ran on "2026-10-25"
When it runs again on "2026-10-25"
Then no late fee and no ledger entry changes
